title: Actively maintained replication code and reproducibility report for Peer, Orr, and Coppock (2021, PS)
description:
Actively maintained replication code and reproducibility report for Peer, Orr, and Coppock (2021, PS).

The original deposit holds the data and codebook but no code. The maintained version supplies code that runs on current R and current packages, operating directly on the data as originally deposited, and reproduces the article's table and every count in its text. The repository also holds the ground truth comparing every published claim against the maintained code, and the itemized errata. This record's concept DOI always resolves to the latest version.
